content.text: Requesting a published book detail page that does not exist returns an HTTP 404.

judgements.rationale: [risk_factors] The missing-book 404 behavior is public and visible to any visitor, so user-reach applies. The source does not indicate money, auth, or data-loss risk for this promise.
[applicability] Applicable: **sc-26** inspects an existing book detail page and therefore should prove the published-via package statement.
[applicability] Applicable: **sc-26** inspects the package attribution area and should prove that the package name links to the package page.
[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-26** stays on the successful detail page and does not activate the publishing CTA, so it does not prove the `/publish` destination.
[applicability] Applicable: **sc-26** inspects the successful detail page and should prove the title is shown.
[applicability] Applicable: **sc-26** inspects the successful detail page and should prove the author line is shown in the required form.
[applicability] Applicable: **sc-26** inspects the successful detail page and should prove the genre is shown.
[applicability] Applicable: **sc-26** inspects the successful detail page and should prove the rating is shown in the required form.
[applicability] Applicable: **sc-26** inspects the successful detail page and should prove the format is shown.
[applicability] Applicable: **sc-26** inspects the successful detail page and should prove a valid ISBN-13 is shown.
[applicability] Applicable: **sc-26** inspects the successful detail page and should prove the publication month/year is shown.
[applicability] Applicable: **sc-26** inspects the successful detail page and should prove the blurb is shown.
[applicability] Applicable: **sc-26** inspects the successful detail page and should prove the cover image is shown.
[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-27** is focused on activating the publishing CTA and routing away, not on proving the published-via statement itself.
[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-27** does not exercise the package-name link; it exercises the separate publishing CTA route.
[applicability] Applicable: **sc-27** exists specifically to prove that the `Publish your book like this one` CTA leads to `/publish`.
[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-27** does not aim to prove the page title content; its distinct outcome is CTA routing.
[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-27** does not aim to prove the author-line content; its distinct outcome is CTA routing.
[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-27** does not aim to prove the genre content; its distinct outcome is CTA routing.

[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-27** does not aim to prove the publication-date content; its distinct outcome is CTA routing.
[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-27** does not aim to prove the blurb content; its distinct outcome is CTA routing.
[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-27** does not aim to prove the cover-image content; its distinct outcome is CTA routing.
[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-28** requests a nonexistent book, so no successful detail page exists on which to show the published-via statement.
[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-28** requests a nonexistent book, so there is no package-name link to prove.
[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-28** ends in a 404 outcome rather than a successful detail page with a CTA to activate.
[applicability] Not applicable: **sc-28** requests a nonexistent book, so the detail-page title promise does not apply.
